* an expanded SignerInfo block from a CMS Signed message
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: private byte[] encodeObj(ASN1Encodable obj) throws IOException
public int getVersion()
methods.comment: * return the version number for this objects underlying SignerInfo structure.

methods.name: public String getDigestAlgOID()
methods.comment: * return the object identifier for the signature.

methods.name: public byte[] getDigestAlgParams()
methods.comment: * return the signature parameters, or null if there aren't any.

methods.name: public byte[] getContentDigest()
methods.comment: * return the content digest that was calculated during verification.

methods.name: public String getEncryptionAlgOID()
methods.comment: * return the object identifier for the signature.

methods.name: public byte[] getEncryptionAlgParams()
methods.comment:
* return the signature/encryption algorithm parameters, or null if
     * there aren't any.

methods.name: public AttributeTable getSignedAttributes()
methods.comment:
* return a table of the signed attributes - indexed by
     * the OID of the attribute.

methods.name: public AttributeTable getUnsignedAttributes()
methods.comment:
* return a table of the unsigned attributes indexed by
     * the OID of the attribute.

methods.name: public SignerInformationStore getCounterSignatures()
methods.comment:
* Return a SignerInformationStore containing the counter signatures attached to this
     * signer. If no counter signatures are present an empty store is returned.

methods.name: public byte[] getEncodedSignedAttributes() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* return the DER encoding of the signed attributes.
     * @throws IOException if an encoding error occurs.

methods.name: private boolean doVerify(SignerInformationVerifier verifier) throws CMSException
public boolean verify(SignerInformationVerifier verifier) throws CMSException
methods.comment:
* Verify that the given verifier can successfully verify the signature on
     * this SignerInformation object.
     *
     * @param verifier a suitably configured SignerInformationVerifier.
     * @return true if the signer information is verified, false otherwise.
     * @throws com.android.internal.org.bouncycastle.cms.CMSVerifierCertificateNotValidException if the provider has an associated certificate and the certificate is not valid at the time given as the SignerInfo's signing time.
     * @throws com.android.internal.org.bouncycastle.cms.CMSException if the verifier is unable to create a ContentVerifiers or DigestCalculators.

methods.name: public SignerInfo toASN1Structure()
methods.comment:
* Return the underlying ASN.1 object defining this SignerInformation object.
     *
     * @return a SignerInfo.

methods.name: private ASN1Primitive getSingleValuedSignedAttribute(ASN1ObjectIdentifier attrOID, String printableName) throws CMSException
public static SignerInformation replaceUnsignedAttributes(SignerInformation signerInformation, AttributeTable unsignedAttributes)
methods.comment:
* Return a signer information object with the passed in unsigned
     * attributes replacing the ones that are current associated with
     * the object passed in.
     * 
     * @param signerInformation the signerInfo to be used as the basis.
     * @param unsignedAttributes the unsigned attributes to add.
     * @return a copy of the original SignerInformationObject with the changed attributes.

methods.name: public static SignerInformation addCounterSigners(SignerInformation signerInformation, SignerInformationStore counterSigners)
methods.comment:
* Return a signer information object with passed in SignerInformationStore representing counter
     * signatures attached as an unsigned attribute.
     *
     * @param signerInformation the signerInfo to be used as the basis.
     * @param counterSigners signer info objects carrying counter signature.
     * @return a copy of the original SignerInformationObject with the changed attributes.
